approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with ReXGlue; native Linux AppImage with themed launcher, Windows build from CI
notes: Linux v1.2.1 released: title update 2 (0.0.2.5) support as a second build picked automatically by the launcher, DLC import from Xbox 360 packages or archives, full-speed 60 fps fights, no /dev/shm leaks on crashes. Windows build is a test pre-release, not yet confirmed on native hardware. Offline play only - no online versus. Game, title update and DLC files are not included; bring your own.
